method: Web search over public reporting (2026-11-26, Asia/Taipei morning). candidates.title: NBA's first month of 2026-27 draws 75M+ U.S. viewers, the most in league history (league release, Mon Nov 23)

evidence.notes: Verified from the NBA.com release snippet ('First month of NBA season reaches more than 75 million viewers') and agreeing Forbes/Barrett/Yahoo reports dated Nov 23: (1) more than 75 million U.S. viewers in the first month across NBC/Peacock, Prime Video and ESPN; (2) highest opening month in league history, up 20% year over year; (3) games averaging 2.62 million viewers, a record through this point of any season; (4) adults 18-34 viewership up 50%. Not used: the '+37% national average' figure (in Yahoo/RealGM headlines but not seen in the NBA.com snippet). Caveat reported by Hollywood Reporter: Nielsen measurement changes have tended to benefit live sports.
